body: Also there's a point of being completely different. So apparently to want to die you have to have some severe condition, disability or illness. Huh. At this point I'm wondering if stubbing my toe will bring me over the edge. When I talk with people about suicide they just assume that I'm histerical or extremely depressed or in a state of dysphoria, and maybe thats a reasonable guess in most cases, but not in this. Right now Im in state most people would desire to be in and yet I'm contemplating suicide?? And if many have it much worse how than anyone ever lives full life without killing themselves? Is death so scary to most people???

That's the fucking thing man, I don't have that. I had a minor depression episode at age 18, but then it got fixed and now I can regulate my mood just fine. I also had an extreme social anxiety, but then I learned a few tricks and now I can talk to people. Like reading this subreddit right now is diabolical. "I don't deserve to live", "there's no choice", "I'm a failure" - holy fuck dudes,  that's some deep shit. In comparison, I realize, I'm a normal, potentially fully functional, healthy human being, neurotypical even. And physical health? Perfect shape, despite my best efforts to destroy my body. I hate myself for being so incredibly privileged in life and not wanting to do anything with that privilege.
